title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Role - Software Engineering Manager 
 Overview 
 This position is hybrid in Atlanta, Georgia and sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment.
 The Opportunity 
 The Manager, Software Engineering is a hands-on technical leader responsible for driving innovation, adopting new technologies, and leading change. The ideal candidate demonstrates technical depth and strong architectural understanding, enabling them to coach engineering teams, participate in feasibility discussions, support technical decisions, and is passionate about enabling modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development. In addition to removing blockers and maximizing team productivity, this leader champions scalable solutions and guides teams through change with empathy and clarity.
 Responsibilities 
 What Youll Be Doing Lead, mentor, and support a distributed team of Software Engineers, developing personalized career paths, and encouraging continuous upskilling including the use of AI-assisted tools for coding, documentation, testing, and code review. Provide strong technical guidance and foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ethical use of AI across the team. Support engineers in maintaining focus and delivering quality outcomes by ensuring they understand clear priorities, allocating resources effectively, and resolving blockers early. Participate in architecture discussions, advocating for scalable, AI-ready systems, and modern development practices. Maintain and evolve a high-performing team culture by hiring top talent and reinforcing our values of excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Track, analyze, and report on key engineering performance metrics (e.g., velocity, quality, cycle time), using insights to drive continuous improvement in team effectiveness and delivery outcomes. This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications 
 What You Bring to the Team BS in Computer Science or a related field, or demonstrable equivalent experience. 8+ years of professional software development experience using technologies such as C#, WPF, Java, Python, and/or JavaScript. 4+ years of leadership experience with a focus on mentorship, career growth, and delivery. Proven ability to mentor engineers and lead technical discussions, from architecture to implementation. Strong grasp of software engineering best practices: Agile workflows, CI/CD, TDD, code reviews, and build/release automation. Experience working with Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with short release cycles and products in active production use. Deep knowledge of OOP principles, data structures, and algorithms. Demonstrated experience evaluating and integrating AI tools into development workflows, debugging, and CI/CD pipelines. Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills. Committed to sound business ethics and handling of confidential information. Experience working in Product Operating Model is a plus.

Key Skills: Engineering Management,C#,Java,Software Engineering,GCP,Agile,People Management Skills,Python

Your typical day will involve applying Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), Gemini models, and RAG-based retrieval techniques as part of production-ready GenAI solutions.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are looking for an experienced and strategic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead the company's technology vision, engineering strategy, technical operations, and innovation initiatives. The CTO will be responsible for building and scaling high-performing engineering teams, defining technology architecture and standards, overseeing software delivery and cloud infrastructure, strengthening cybersecurity, and ensuring that technology investments are aligned with the company's business objectives. The ideal candidate should combine strong technical depth with business leadership , with experience managing complex software projects, cloud platforms, engineering teams, client-facing technology engagements, and enterprise-scale systems. 
 Preferred candidate profile Technology Strategy & Leadership Define and execute the company's short-term and long-term technology strategy in alignment with business objectives. Work closely with the Founder/CEO and leadership team on technology investments, product strategy, digital transformation, and organizational growth. Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve business efficiency, service offerings, and competitive positioning. Establish engineering standards, architecture principles, development methodologies, and technology governance. Build a technology roadmap supporting scalability, security, reliability, and future business expansion. Engineering & Software Delivery Provide leadership across software engineering, architecture, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, QA, and related technology functions. Oversee the architecture and delivery of web, mobile, cloud, SaaS, eCommerce, and enterprise applications. Ensure projects are delivered with appropriate standards for quality, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability. Establish effective code review, testing, CI/CD, release management, and deployment practices. Review critical technical designs and guide teams in resolving complex architecture and production challenges. Drive modernization of legacy systems and adoption of appropriate modern technologies. Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure Define the company's cloud and infrastructure strategy across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) . Oversee cloud architecture, Kubernetes/container environments, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and disaster recovery. Establish high availability, backup, business continuity, and disaster recovery standards. Optimize infrastructure performance and cloud expenditure while maintaining reliability and scalability. Promote Infrastructure as Code and automation using technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or equivalent platforms. Cybersecurity & Risk Management Establish and continuously improve the organization's cybersecurity framework. Ensure appropriate controls for application security, infrastructure security, identity and access management, data protection, vulnerability management, and incident response. Implement security practices throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Oversee technology risk assessments, security audits, penetration testing, backup policies, and disaster recovery exercises. Support compliance with applicable security, privacy, and client requirements. AI, Automation & Innovation Develop a practical strategy for adopting Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, automation, and data-driven technologies . Identify opportunities to incorporate AI into internal operations, software development, client solutions, and products. Evaluate new frameworks, platforms, tools, and technologies based on measurable business value rather than technology trends alone. Encourage experimentation and innovation while maintaining appropriate security and governance. Team Building & Engineering Culture Recruit, mentor, develop, and retain high-performing technology leaders and engineering professionals. Establish clear organizational structures, responsibilities, career paths, and performance expectations across technology teams. Mentor Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, DevOps Engineers, and senior developers. Build a culture focused on ownership, engineering excellence, continuous learning, collaboration, and accountability. Conduct technical leadership reviews and identify skill gaps and training requirements. Client & Stakeholder Management Participate in technical discussions with clients, prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders. Translate business requirements into appropriate technical solutions and architecture. Support pre-sales activities including solution architecture, technical estimations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and technical presentations. Provide executive-level communication for critical projects, technical risks, security incidents, and technology transformation initiatives. Build confidence with enterprise clients through strong technical governance and delivery practices. Technology Governance & KPIs Establish measurable KPIs for engineering productivity, software quality, infrastructure reliability, security, project delivery, and technology costs. Monitor areas such as deployment frequency, production incidents, system availability, defect rates, security vulnerabilities, infrastructure expenditure, and delivery predictability. Conduct periodic architecture, security, infrastructure, and engineering reviews. Establish appropriate documentation and knowledge-management practices. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related discipline. 12+ years of overall technology experience , with significant experience in senior engineering or technology leadership positions. 5+ years of experience managing engineering teams, technical leaders, architects, or technology departments. Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and enterprise application development. Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP . Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, monitoring, observability, and DevOps practices . Understanding of modern frontend and backend technology ecosystems such as React/Next.js, Node.js, PHP/Laravel, .NET, Java, Python, or comparable technologies. Strong understanding of relational and NoSQL databases, caching, messaging, and search technologies. Solid knowledge of cybersecurity, secure application development, infrastructure security, and data protection. Experience managing large-scale software projects and multiple engineering teams simultaneously. Experience with client-facing technical consulting, solution architecture, or technology services is highly desirable. Leadership Competencies The successful candidate should demonstrate: Strategic and commercial thinking Strong technology and architecture judgment People and organizational leadership Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills Ability to communicate complex technology concepts to non-technical leadership Strong ownership and accountability Ability to operate effectively in a fast-growing and changing technology environment Balance between innovation, delivery speed, security, cost, and engineering quality Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous: IT services / software development organizations Enterprise software development SaaS platforms eCommerce platforms such as Magento/Adobe Commerce Cloud migration and modernization AI/ML and Generative AI solutions DevOps and platform engineering Cybersecurity and compliance High-availability and disaster-recovery architecture International client management Technical pre-sales and solution consulting

title: Power BI Senior Engineer
description:
Job Summary 
 SEI is looking for a talented and detail-oriented Power BI Developer (Software Engineer III) to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, deploy and maintain scalable BI solutions using Microsoft Power BI. You will collaborate closely with multiple stakeholders to understand reporting needs and deliver insightful, visually compelling dashboards and reports that drive data-driven decision-making. 
 
 What you will do: 
 Develop, publish, and maintain interactive reports and dashboards using Power BI Translate business requirements into technical specifications and produce effective visualizations Work with various data sources including SQL Server, CosmosDB, Snowflake, Excel, SharePoint, APIs, and cloud services (Azure, etc.) Optimize dashboards with a focus on usability and performance Implement row-level security (RLS) and other data governance protocols Collaborate with business analysts to iterate reporting needs Build, Deploy and Maintain data models using Power Query (M), DAX, and Power BI datasets. Provide technical support and documentation 
 
 What we need from you: 
 Very strong Power BI development skills including Power BI Desktop (report development) Power BI Service (publishing, workspaces, sharing) Strong T-SQL and Query Language for Cosmos DB skills for writing, debugging, and tuning stored procedures, views, and SQL queries. Strong Power Query skills (M Language) Experience in at least one full end-to-end PowerBI implementation Experience in fabric workspace and deployment process Knowledge on workspace configuration and access control Experience with data modeling Experience with DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) for calculated columns, measures, KPIs 
 
 What we would like from you: 
 Bachelor's (or above) degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field Minimum 6 years of experience with Power BI and Microsoft SQL Server programming or Cosmos DB Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment Excellent communication and collaboration skills Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun.
